title: Arab Iraq
capsule: The entity recorded under this Wikidata item (Q6000379) corresponds to Arab Iraq in the Wikidata source, referring to a short-lived Hashemite-connected political arrangement in Iraq dated approximately 1415–1440 in the Cliopatria dataset; this appears to represent a transitional Arab/tribal political configuration in the Mesopotamian region during a period of Timurid suzerainty and post-Jalayirid fragmentation. The historical record for a distinct 'Hashemite Arab Federation' in this period is not corroborated by standard reference works, and the label likely reflects a dataset-specific classification for loose Arab tribal confederacy influence in the region between Timurid and later Aq Qoyunlu domination.
attestation: Boundaries from Seshat Cliopatria (Bennett et al., Scientific Data 2025; CC BY 4.0), digitized from standard historical atlases at ~0.07° resolution. The territorial extent and even the political identity of this entity as a distinct polity is poorly attested; the Wikidata item links to 'Arab Iraq' which does not correspond to a well-documented political unit in medieval sources, and spatial reconstruction is highly speculative.
